messages:
maria: Quick API question before I open a PR — thinking of exposing a breakdown of cached tokens by origin (prompt vs completion) in /v1/usage. Wanted quick takes on compatibility and billing implications.

maria: Proposed opt-in param: `?cached_origin=true`. Response would include `usage.cached_tokens_origin = { prompt: X, completion: Y }` while still returning `usage.cached_tokens` as the canonical sum.

raj: Fine with the breakdown as long as it stays informational. Billing MUST continue to use `chargeable_tokens` as the single source of truth. If we change invoices later we can make it authoritative, but not now.

anna: For older SDKs: always keep `cached_tokens` present and unchanged. New field can be optional and behind the opt-in. SDKs can synthesize sum(breakdown) into `cached_tokens` if they want, but server must always return the sum too.

zach: Runtime note: we tag KV entries with origin already, so computing per-request origin counts is cheap. Edge-case: shared prefixes reused in the same request or across internal retries — we must define we count "unique cached tokens applied to the request" and dedupe per KV entry id.

maria: Draft doc blurb: "`cached_tokens` = unique cached tokens applied to this request. `cached_tokens_origin` (if present) breaks that set into origins: prompt vs completion. Servers must ensure sum(origin) == cached_tokens for parity." Thoughts?

raj: Sounds good. Also default the opt-in to false to avoid increasing response sizes for everyone. Make the param `cached_origin=true` explicit.

anna: We'll add compatibility tests: if `cached_tokens_origin` present then assert `cached_tokens == prompt + completion`. Add a billing-recon unit that fails the ingest if mismatch.

billing-bot: ACCOUNTING NOTE: Our invoice formula is still `chargeable_tokens = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens - cached_tokens`. If origin breakdown is provided, `cached_tokens` MUST equal sum of breakdown values. Any divergence triggers a recon alert.

zach: Example (opt-in response) for spec page — included as a code block here for clarity:

```
{
  "usage": "{ prompt_tokens: 210, completion_tokens: 110, cached_tokens: 50, cached_tokens_origin: { prompt: 30, completion: 20 }, chargeable_tokens: 270 }"
}
```

maria: Nice. I'll draft the API PR with: (1) opt-in query flag default false, (2) returned `cached_tokens` always, (3) optional `cached_tokens_origin` when requested, and (4) explicit doc about deduping by KV id. I'll tag @anna and @raj for tests and accounting updates.

anna: Ping me when the PR is up — I'll add SDK compatibility mappings and tests in billing-recon.

raj: I'll update the accounting docs and add an ingest-time rule: if breakdown exists, check equality with `cached_tokens` and flag differences. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks all — closing thread, will post PR link here once opened. :sparkles:
